The operating token mamela@pve!lab gets exactly these privileges (from the provider's manifest):

/pool/lab (role MamelaLabVM)
  Pool.Audit                 observe
  VM.Allocate                create-vm, delete-vm, create-template, finish-template, delete-template
  VM.Audit                   observe, create-vm, create-template
  VM.Clone                   create-vm
  VM.Config.CDROM            create-vm, finish-clone
  VM.Config.CPU              create-vm, finish-clone, resize-vm, configure-lxc
  VM.Config.Disk             create-vm, grow-vm-disk, create-template, grow-lxc-rootfs
  VM.Config.HWType           create-vm, create-template
  VM.Config.Memory           create-vm, finish-clone, resize-vm, configure-lxc
  VM.Config.Network          create-vm, create-template
  VM.Config.Options          create-vm, tag-vm, adopt-vm, create-template, finish-template, configure-lxc, adopt-lxc
  VM.PowerMgmt               start-vm, resize-vm, shutdown-vm, delete-vm, reboot-vm, reset-vm, stop-vm, start-lxc, shutdown-lxc, reboot-lxc, stop-lxc

/sdn/zones/localnetwork/vmbr0 (role MamelaLabNet)
  SDN.Use                    create-vm, create-template

/storage/local (role MamelaLabImage)
  Datastore.AllocateTemplate create-vm, finish-clone, create-template
  Datastore.Audit            observe, create-vm, finish-clone, create-template

/storage/local-lvm (role MamelaLabDisk)
  Datastore.AllocateSpace    create-vm, grow-vm-disk, create-template, grow-lxc-rootfs

/vms/150 (role MamelaLabNamedChange)
  named guest: lxc on pve2, access change
  VM.Audit                   observe
  VM.Config.CPU              configure-lxc
  VM.Config.Disk             grow-lxc-rootfs
  VM.Config.Memory           configure-lxc
  VM.Config.Options          configure-lxc, adopt-lxc
  VM.PowerMgmt               start-lxc, shutdown-lxc, reboot-lxc, stop-lxc

A pool's privileges reach the VMs in it (/vms/7000..7009). The guard blocks an apply when the token holds
anything else, or lacks any of these. The audit token mamela-audit@pve!audit gets PVEAuditor (read-only) on /.
A named guest's privileges are on its /vms/<vmid> only: with access "observe", VM.Audit (Mamela sees it and changes nothing);
with "change", also what adopting and changing it need. A person decides when to give "change": set it in the guest's
[[provider.proxmox.guard.named]] entry, then run the bootstrap script again.
